top_reply.author: @ceo_of_racism_001
top_reply.text: You're technically correct, the best kind of correct. No matter what these guys say, it does indeed get heavier, although it's so infinitesimally small, i'm not even sure we can measure it. A small electrical charge gets stored between various layers of insulation, for every bit of data the storage drive switches from 0 to 1. This obviously applies to solid storage (which the phone uses). When the drive wants to access and read the data, if the charge is strong enough, it'll be read as 1, else if its low or absent, it's a 0.
